name: nnInteractive
plain: nnInteractive (DKFZ): a promptable 3D segmenter: click a point, draw a box or a scribble on any structure in a CT, MRI, PET or microscopy volume and it returns that structure's 3D mask; further prompts (positive or negative) refine it. Non-commercial weights (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).
summary: nnInteractive (Isensee et al. 2025): DKFZ's promptable 3D segmentation for CT, MRI, PET and 3D microscopy. Point, box (2D or 3D) and scribble prompts, positive or negative, refine one object mask in a session; a ResEnc-L U-Net on 192³ patches with AutoZoom (zooms out up to 4x while the mask grows past the patch, then refines the changed region at full resolution). Lasso prompts and initial masks are not ported.
limitations: On the RTX 5060 Ti, preparing a 192³ network patch at 2.25× AutoZoom took 43.2 ms and 2,575 MiB peak allocation, down from 50.9 ms and 5,081 MiB on the same synthetic session state. Tested zoomed patches and prompted CT masks matched bit for bit in the paired runs.
task_io: Input: a CT volume `[D, H, W]` in Hounsfield units and its voxel spacing in mm (`volume.read_nifti` reads both from a NIfTI file). Output: a class index per voxel `[D, H, W]` on the input grid (0 = background). Encoder models (nnFoundation) take a CT or MRI volume and give its encoder feature maps. For a trained nnU-Net v2 folder or checkpoint, see the [nnU-Net v2 loader](../api/volume.md#nnu-net-v2).

quality.title: TotalSegmentator test subset (8 CT cases x 12 prompts), mean Dice vs the ground-truth mask
quality.protocol: A small subset of real CT cases of the TotalSegmentator dataset (not the full test split), each run at its card's spacing (1.5 or 3 mm) in the same pipeline; mean over the cases of the Dice (0 to 1) averaged over the classes present, against the ground-truth segmentations (vertebrae_L6 of the subset has no counterpart and is skipped). Original = TotalSegmentator 2.18.0, default fp16 autocast. nnInteractive: per case 12 simulated prompts (point, box, scribble, point + box on 3 organs), one interaction each; Dice of the predicted mask against the ground-truth organ mask, mean over the runs. Agreement is Dice against the original FP16 or portable FP16 mask as labelled.

original16.note: 8 TotalSegmentator cases x 12 prompts (point, box, scribble, point+box x 3 classes), Dice vs the ground-truth mask; agree = Dice vs the original's mask; original = fp16 autocast

portable.note: 8 TotalSegmentator cases x 12 prompts (point, box, scribble, point+box x 3 classes), Dice vs the ground-truth mask; agree = Dice vs the original's mask; original = fp16 autocast

kernels.note: 8 TotalSegmentator cases x 12 prompts (point, box, scribble, point+box x 3 classes), Dice vs the ground-truth mask; agree = Dice vs the original's mask; original = fp16 autocast

tensorrt.note: Existing CT prompt protocol; portable agreement uses the stored portable FP16 masks. TensorRT runs the prepared patch U-Net inside the existing session.
